findings.text: sync_holds accepts raise_fn/clear_fn override parameters that exist only to preserve caller-module monkeypatching; a future caller can pass a different writer and reintroduce the drift the node removes, and the parameters are undocumented (typed Any).

The recorded gate names six test files, but tests/standard_names/test_docs_contradiction_veto.py:151, tests/standard_names/test_bare_doc_link_normalize.py:264 and tests/standard_names/test_doc_link_accept_gate.py:36 patch clear_holds_not_raised on the boundary this change reroutes, and none of those arms appear in a base or head log, so a regression at the injected boundary in that path is unmeasured.
